llm.evidence: Desalted peptides were analyzed on a Q-Exactive (Thermo Scientific) attached to an EasyLC system run at 300 nL/min.
LFQ (Label-free quantification) and iBAQ (intensity-based absolute-protein-quantification) were enabled.
and then digested with trypsin (1:50 ratio) at 37°C with shaking for 16 hrs.
Data dependent acquisition mode with a dynamic exclusion of 45 s was enabled.
Ions were fragmented using higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with collision energy of 27%.
Denaturation/reduction was performed in 8 M urea/5 mM dithiothreitol/25 mM NH4HCO3 (pH 8.0) for over 60 min in 52°C.
The solution was stored at room temperature in 25 mM iodoacetamide at the dark for 60 min.
